description: Defines SQLAlchemy and Pydantic models for user and item management, including database schemas, API schemas, and utility functions.

classes.name: UserBase
classes.description: Base class for user properties, used in multiple user-related schemas.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new user, extends UserBase with password field.

classes.name: UserRegister
classes.description: Schema for user registration API, includes email, password, and full name.

classes.name: UserUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating user info, all fields optional.

classes.name: UserUpdateMe
classes.description: Schema for updating current user's profile.

classes.name: UpdatePassword
classes.description: Schema for password update, includes current and new password.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user, with UUID primary key and relationships.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Schema for publicly exposing user info.

classes.name: UsersPublic
classes.description: Schema for a list of public user data.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Database model for items, with foreign key to user.

classes.name: ItemPublic
classes.description: Schema for publicly exposing item info.

classes.name: ItemsPublic
classes.description: Schema for a list of public item data.

classes.name: NewPassword
classes.description: Schema for setting a new password, includes token and new password.
